checked_profile.summary: Auto coverage with local agents and driving-based discount programs.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Coverage choices
facts.text: State Farm lists liability, comprehensive, collision, and uninsured or underinsured motorist coverages.

facts.label: Driving programs
facts.text: Drive Safe & Save and Steer Clear are advertised discount programs. Steer Clear targets eligible drivers under 25; eligibility and state rules apply.

facts.label: Claims channels
facts.text: Claims can be reported online, through the mobile app, or by phone. The product page also provides local-agent access.
